questions.question: Dr. Imad must train young dentists in ethics. What is the first piece of advice he should give them?
options: Ethics is at the heart of the trusting relationship with the patient
questions.explanation: Dr. Imad explains: 'Ethics is at the heart of the trusting relationship with the patient. It gives meaning to our practice.' Dr. Soundous: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Soundous must create a training center in dental ethics. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: Dr. Soundous explains: 'The main objective is to train dentists in ethical reflection and decision-making.' Dr. Imad: 'I will participate in this training.'

questions.question: Dr. Imad must evaluate a young dentist's ethical performance. Which measure is most important?
options: The quality of the patient relationship and respect for ethical principles
questions.explanation: Dr. Imad explains: 'The quality of the patient relationship and respect for ethical principles are the most important measures.' Dr. Soundous: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Soundous must manage an ethical crisis: a patient has filed a complaint for an ethical breach. What is the priority?
options: Protect the patient and the image of the profession
questions.explanation: Dr. Soundous explains: 'The priority is to protect the patient and the image of the profession.' Dr. Imad: 'I will help you manage this crisis.'

questions.question: Dr. Imad must train interns in ethical risk management. What is the fundamental principle?
options: Ethical risk management is a professional responsibility
questions.explanation: Dr. Imad explains: 'Ethical risk management is a fundamental professional responsibility.' Dr. Soundous: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Soundous must create a guide to good ethical practices. What is the main reference?
options: The Code of Ethics and fundamental ethical principles
questions.explanation: Dr. Soundous explains: 'Good practices must be based on the Code of Ethics and fundamental ethical principles.' Dr. Imad: 'I will contribute to this guide.'

questions.question: Dr. Imad must train young dentists in managing conflicts of interest. What is the key message?
options: Conflicts of interest must be declared and managed
Conflicts of interest are a constraint
questions.explanation: Dr. Imad explains: 'Conflicts of interest must be declared and managed to preserve professional integrity.' Dr. Soundous: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Soundous must create a research program in dental ethics. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: Dr. Soundous explains: 'Research in dental ethics aims to improve practices and decision-making.' Dr. Imad: 'I will participate in the research.'

questions.question: Dr. Imad must manage a reference practice in ethics. What is the pillar of excellence?
questions.explanation: Dr. Imad explains: 'Excellence is based on integrity and patient trust.' Dr. Soundous: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Soundous must evaluate the impact of ethics on public health. What is the role of ethics?
options: It is essential for patient trust
questions.explanation: Dr. Soundous explains: 'Ethics is essential for patient trust and quality of care.' Dr. Imad: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Imad must train interns in ethical innovation. What current trend is important?
questions.explanation: Dr. Imad explains: 'Ethical innovation concerns digital ethics, new technologies, and bioethics issues.' Dr. Soundous: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Soundous must create an ethical skills assessment system. What is the objective?
questions.explanation: Dr. Soundous explains: 'Assessment of ethical skills aims to improve practices.' Dr. Imad: 'I will participate in the assessment.'

questions.question: Dr. Imad must manage an ethical conflict related to the use of AI. What is the right attitude?
options: Act in accordance with the Code of Ethics and ethical principles
questions.explanation: Dr. Imad explains: 'The Code of Ethics is the guide for resolving ethical conflicts related to new technologies.' Dr. Soundous: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Soundous must write an article on the future of dental ethics. What trend should be highlighted?
options: Ethics in service of innovation and the patient
questions.explanation: Dr. Soundous explains: 'The future of ethics is based on its service to innovation and the patient.' Dr. Imad: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Imad must create an ethical quality label for practices. What are the main criteria?
questions.explanation: Dr. Imad explains: 'Integrity, transparency, and patient trust are the fundamental criteria.' Dr. Soundous: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Soundous must give a speech on the importance of ethics. What message should she convey?
options: Ethics is the foundation of the profession
questions.explanation: Dr. Soundous explains: 'Ethics is the foundation of the dental profession.' Dr. Imad: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Imad must create a scholarship for dental ethics students. What is the objective?
questions.explanation: Dr. Imad explains: 'Encouraging excellence in ethics is an investment for the future.' Dr. Soundous: 'I will support this initiative.'

questions.question: Dr. Soundous must pass on her knowledge of ethics. What is the most effective method?
questions.explanation: Dr. Soundous explains: 'Personalized mentoring and practical cases are the most effective methods.' Dr. Imad: 'I will get involved in mentoring.'

questions.question: Dr. Imad must create a peer network for young dentists in ethics. What is the objective?
options: Foster mutual support and experience sharing
questions.explanation: Dr. Imad explains: 'Mutual support and sharing are essential for young dentists in ethics.' Dr. Soundous: 'I will support this network.'

questions.question: Dr. Soundous must write a conclusion to her book on ethics. What is the final sentence?
options: Ethics is the soul of the patient relationship
questions.explanation: Dr. Soundous explains: 'Ethics is the soul of the patient relationship.' Dr. Imad: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Imad must leave a legacy to the profession. What is the most beautiful legacy?
options: Ethical values and an example to follow
questions.explanation: Dr. Imad explains: 'Ethical values and the example are the most beautiful legacy one can leave.' Dr. Soundous: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Soundous must train future ethics mentors. What is the first message to convey?
options: Mentoring is a mission of support and transmission of ethical values
Mentoring is a source of income
questions.explanation: Dr. Soundous explains: 'Mentoring is a mission of support and transmission of ethical values.' Dr. Imad: 'I will convey this message.'

questions.question: Dr. Imad must write a letter to future dentists about ethics. What message should he convey?
options: Ethics is a fundamental pillar of the profession
questions.explanation: Dr. Imad explains: 'Ethics is a fundamental pillar of the profession.' Dr. Soundous: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Soundous must create an award for young dentists in ethics. What is the purpose?
questions.explanation: Dr. Soundous explains: 'Stimulating excellence in ethics is essential for the evolution of the profession.' Dr. Imad: 'I will support this award.'

questions.question: Dr. Imad, after a career dedicated to ethics, receives national recognition. Dr. Soundous is by his side. What is Dr. Imad's message to young dentists?
options: Ethics is the heart of the patient relationship
questions.explanation: Dr. Imad concludes: 'Ethics is the heart of the patient relationship. It gives meaning to our practice.' Dr. Soundous: 'I am proud of you.'
